definitions.explanation: An argument or outlook holding that a situation will turn out well. Like {悲観論|ひかんろん}, it names a stated position in a debate rather than a personality trait, and is often used with a hint that the position may be too easy.

examples.japanese: {楽観論|らっかんろん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧。
⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{楽観論|らっかんろん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Optimism is spreading in the market.

examples.japanese: ⟦{根拠|こんきょ}→根拠：10147_konkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧{楽観論|らっかんろん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遅|おく}らせる→遅らせる：02480_okuraseru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧だ。

notes:
⟦{楽観|らっかん}→楽観：17126_rakkan⟧ (optimism) + ⟦{論|ろん}→〜論：04017_ron⟧ (argument, theory). Note the small っ in らっかん.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {楽観論|らっかんろん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: for optimism to spread
- ⟦{根拠|こんきょ}→根拠：10147_konkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧{楽観論|らっかんろん}: groundless optimism
- {楽観論|らっかんろん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧: to argue an optimistic case
- {楽観論|らっかんろん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{悲観論|ひかんろん}→悲観論：30516_hikanron⟧: the optimistic and pessimistic cases

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{楽観的|らっかんてき}→楽観的：06090_rakkanteki⟧: optimistic — the adjective, describing a person or an outlook
- ⟦{悲観論|ひかんろん}→悲観論：30516_hikanron⟧: pessimistic view — the direct opposite
